verdict.rationale: Chargeback and dispute handling is a fair question for a Merchant of Record payments platform like Polar, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions disputes, chargebacks, evidence submission or dispute-lifecycle tracking. Refunds, dunning and webhooks are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can respond to a chargeback with structured evidence and track the dispute lifecycle to resolution
